text: Riya just posted her fifth reel this week. Two hundred views. Again.
Her script was written by AI. So was everyone else's.
Because she typed what every beginner types: write me a reel script.
So this time, she gave the AI four pieces instead of one.
Who she is. A fitness creator with three thousand followers.
Who it's for. Busy beginners who skip the gym.
The hook. Open with a mistake they're making.
And the format. Thirty seconds, three tips.
Same AI. But this time, the script sounded like her.
And her next reel didn't blend in.
Comment PROMPT, and I'll send you ten prompts like hers, ready to copy.
